action_instruction: Checking the Netflix subscription billing period and price
intent: whether the Netflix subscription entry shows a Monthly billing period and a $15.99 price

action_params.condition: The subscription list shows "Netflix" with "Monthly" and "$15.99".
action_params.query: whether the Netflix subscription entry shows a Monthly billing period and a $15.99 price
action_params.code_js: (() => { const text = el(18).innerText; return text.includes('Netflix') && text.includes('Monthly') && text.includes('$15.99'); })()

assertion_tree.description: the subscription list shows "Netflix" with "Monthly" and "$15.99"

sub_results.description: The subscription list shows "Netflix" with "Monthly" and "$15.99".

assertion_tree.verification: The subscription list displays Netflix with the Monthly plan and $15.99.
